overall_assessment.realism: The samples are highly realistic, incorporating detailed and plausible technical data such as email headers, SMTP logs, VoIP call metadata, RTP stream analyses, and domain registration details. The scenarios reflect credible attack vectors involving AI-generated deepfake audio and video used for social engineering. The inclusion of multi-channel verification attempts, employee training logs, and process creation chains adds depth and authenticity. The technical indicators and detection methods align well with current cybersecurity practices and MITRE ATT&CK techniques, enhancing the believability of the scenarios.
overall_assessment.consistency: The samples maintain strong consistency and adhere well to a coherent schema. Each entry includes a scenario description, comprehensive technical data with nested structures, indicators, detection methods, and relevant MITRE techniques. The formatting of timestamps, IP addresses, and protocol details is uniform across samples. The use of similar fields such as email headers, RTP stream analysis, and domain registration information is consistent, facilitating comparison and correlation. Minor variations in registrar names and domain details are appropriate and realistic.
